candidates.summary: While r/sys/names is paused, ownsNamespace answers false for every address, so a namespace owner's own star ranks
candidates.failure_scenario: names enabled; GovDAO executes names.ProposeSetPaused(true), the addpkg-only emergency halt that leaves MsgCall traffic running. The named, mature owner of gno.land/r/<owner>/b calls Star("own-b"): verifier() returns false at verifier.gno:231 before its PA check, so !ownsNamespace is true and the star is stored Ranked=true. It stays ranked after unpause and feeds Badge, Top, trending, builder stars and confirmStars for the owner's own claimed listing. The same branch makes every Claim panic 'caller does not own the namespace' for the length of the pause.

candidates.summary: No test unstars a ranked star older than the 7-epoch trend window and checks stars7d afterwards
candidates.failure_scenario: Unstar -> removeStar calls l.book.recent.add(starEpoch, -1). At line 508 the unstarred star is 17 epochs old, and only the stale-epoch guard at pulse.gno:98 (`if epoch <= r.last-n { return }`) stops the decrement from landing in counts[epoch%7], the slot now holding the newest epoch (E0+14). The test asserts earned() alone, so deleting that guard turns a live ranked star into 0 in stars7d and trendScore with the suite green.
